I am very disappointed with my recent experience with Autodoc.I placed an order for Pirelli tires on 27.02.2026 and received them on 11.03.2026. However, I later discovered that the tires have DOT codes from 01/2023 and 02/2023. This means the tires were already over 3 years old at the time of delivery, which is not what I expect when purchasing a “new” product in 2026.Since then, I have been dealing with this issue for almost a month. During this time, I have not been able to complete a necessary tire change, which has affected my ability to use my vehicle safely.In addition, I have had to store, move, and handle four tires multiple times due to this situation, which caused unnecessary physical effort and inconvenience — all because of incorrect or misleading expectations regarding the product.The most frustrating part is the lack of a satisfactory solution. I requested a reasonable compensation, considering the age of the tires and the inconvenience caused. Instead, I received only a minimal offer and repeated delays.I am based in Switzerland, and returning the tires is not simple or cost-effective. Despite this, I was informed that I may need to handle the return logistics myself, which I find unacceptable given that the issue is not caused by me.For a company of this size, I expected a much more customer-oriented approach and a fair resolution.If this matter is not resolved properly, I will consider taking further steps through consumer protection channels.I sincerely hope Autodoc will take this complaint seriously and provide a fair and reasonable solution.

I ordered a SACHS flywheel (2294 501 267) from Autodoc, paying a premium SACHS price.What I received was a broken, recycled LUK flywheel, inside a SACHS box, tied together with zip ties and taped shut. The flywheel had huge play throughout, making it completely unsafe for installation.SACHS/ZF confirmed that this flywheel is not even produced by SACHS, but sourced from LUK for rare VWAG models. Yet Autodoc never disclosed this anywhere, selling it as SACHS at a premium price.The price difference is shocking: in Bulgaria it can be €350–€450, while on other European sites it is only about €150, yet the product inside is identical to a much cheaper LUK part. Autodoc profits massively by misleading customers.This is misleading, unsafe, and completely unacceptable. I returned the part the same day, but Autodoc failed to resolve the issue, leaving my car unusable for 2 months and causing 4 months of delays, frustration, and extra costs.Autodoc must stop misleading customers and clearly disclose when parts are sourced from third parties, especially when they are broken or unsafe.

After 15 Minutes and 27 Seconds you get dropped from the line each time so you get to try again. I have a headset and plenty of time while i was doing other things so I just kept calling. Even tried calling them from 3 lines at once (I got bored) and you get the same message on all of them. That was around 10am on a regular business day. Never got through to anyone then so I tried again in the afternoon and after the second round of waiting I actually got someone who couldn't even say hello or good bye or anything and I tried my best to be extra friendly. I got some results in the form of six emails (one for each part I ordered) saying my return was accepted and an attached PDF Return Form for every part. The english speaking customer service rep was very nice, which was a welcome change so I guess I'll be carefully optimistic and wait.Update (09.07.2018):Turns out they actually did send me three labels - in yet again three separate emails - just two ended up in spam. I guess since it took 40something emails (not even kidding) to get to this point. So I sent the three packages in the same arrangement they came here and apparently they received them on Jul. 2nd. Still waiting to hear anything further. Don't hold your breath on getting your money in any sort of timely fashion back. Mind you I started the Process over a month ago on June 3rd. I do realize the return proves and banks and all that take their sweet time too. I don't have a problem with that, but this is just ridiculous. How does a company with that terrible of a customer service stay in business these days? I've head better customer service from Indian tech support scammers than these guys.
